description: Static components whose licence texts are copied verbatim into THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt. payload_any lists the payload files that embed or ship the component (at least one must exist); external components are not in the payload. A text source of kind 'static' is a file under scripts/release/notices/texts/ (maintainer-supplied); kind 'sysroot' is a file of the Rust toolchain sysroot; kind 'repo' is a file of this repository; kind 'pdfium-archive' takes the LICENSE and licenses/ files of the fetched PDFium archives.
